answer: BGP ASN route-origin bonds gate claims: each identity posts a bond tied to a unique autonomous system number and proves route-origin authorization. A farm spinning N clones needs N distinct ASNs with registered prefixes and transit, costing ~$1200 registration plus $500 monthly per identity. No two clones share one ASN without route-origin validation failures. Bulk-buying fails: registries require organizational verification and peering depends on unique routing history. Detected clusters forfeit bonds and face 20-epoch exclusion. Like a relic in karst, each violet path stands alone.
